line: Milly Rock, Milly Rock, diamonds do the Milly Rock
vault_lines: Milly Rock, Milly Rock, diamonds do the Milly Rock
meaning:
Milly Rock is a dance where the person moves their arms back and forward in a series of circular motions. Also when the light reflects or refracts off diamonds from different angles, they appear to be moving or dancing as they glisten.

21 also used a line similar to this on X featuring Future.

Wrist on Milly Rock them diamonds on me dancin'

line: In Atlanta trap you heard that DefAnition, ya-ya
vault_lines: In Atlanta trap you heard that DefAnition, ya-ya
meaning: This is an obvious name-drop of his mixtape The DefAnition this track happens to be on. While at the same time, he’s calling his mixtape the “DefAnition” of Atlanta trap, making him one of the best rappers in Atlanta. However, since Atlanta is a hip hop hub, he’s got a lot of competition.
